body: KEELYN, the unacknowledged daughter of the mad king Perpentach and a child summoner of demons, leader of the Balseraphs in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: human; girl; about twelve years old; small and slight, a child's build. A pale, freckled, round little face, raven-black hair tied back with a rose-pink bow, large amber eyes.
costume: a gold-and-black harlequin dress with a high ruffled gold collar.
signature: Her small grinning red bat-winged IMP, Puppy, a matching rose-pink bow tied on one of its horns, is always with her.
extra: She is a child and drawn as one: a child's round face and small hands, modest childish clothes, nothing grown-up or glamorous; sweet and a little eerie, her big amber eyes hardly ever blinking.

vibes.name: Mine Forever
vibes.line: both arms wrapped tight around Puppy the imp, hugging him against her cheek; a sweet smile with a stubborn, possessive edge, round unblinking eyes fixed straight on the viewer; a palace balcony at rosy sunset, the carnival city's striped tents and lantern towers below.
vibes.wears: a rose-pink velvet hooded cape, hood down, over a plum-purple dress with a round white lace collar, buttoned to the chin.

vibes.name: Demon Playmates
vibes.line: her right hand pouring from a gold teapot into a tiny cup in a huge demon's claw, her left hand holding the lid on; beaming at her guest; a garden tea party at golden afternoon, horned guests three times her size in shade, in pink bows, Puppy on the table.
vibes.wears: a sunny yellow tea-party dress with white puffed sleeves and a wide white sash, a paper party crown on her head.

vibes.name: Chalk Circle
vibes.line: kneeling on the floor, her right hand chalking the last rune of a small summoning circle starting to glow, her left hand holding open a spellbook; a wide delighted grin, eyes on the circle; a dusty attic at night, lit violet from below, Puppy peering over her shoulder.
vibes.wears: a plain black pinafore smock dusted all over with chalk, over a white blouse with sleeves pushed up, her hair bow knocked askew.

vibes.name: Unacknowledged Princess
vibes.line: seated on her father's throne, too big for her, her right hand holding one claw of the huge horned demon looming protectively behind her in shadow, her left hand stroking Puppy in her lap; chin up, eyes sliding sideways to the bowing ministers; the council hall at grey morning.
vibes.wears: the gold-and-black harlequin dress of her father's court with a high ruffled gold collar, and a small gold circlet she has put on herself.
